notes: Reviewed against contact.png and review.html on 2026-07-06. Preserve timing, animation, hitboxes, effects, sounds, and projectiles.

moves.label: Quick Power Slash
moves.description: Fast high power-sword check with long active coverage at close range.
moves.reason: Short upper-body sword poke with the enlarged blade.

moves.label: Power Sword Body Cut
moves.description: Quick mid sword thrust with a short active window and clean recovery.
moves.reason: Forward thrust travels through the body line.

moves.label: Overhead Power Cleave
moves.description: Slow mid overhead cleave with a moderate active window after the wind-up.
moves.reason: Large vertical blade swing drops into a grounded slash.

moves.label: Low Power Sword Slide
moves.description: Steady low blade slide with a tiny active window and long recovery.
moves.reason: Sliding sword path stays near the opponent's legs.

moves.label: Power Cross Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that drives the oversized blade through the body line.
moves.reason: Cross-slash route is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Low Spirit Wheel
moves.description: Slow low rolling slash with steady active time along the ground.
moves.reason: Low rotating blade arc repeatedly travels around shin height.

moves.label: Leaping Blade Sweep
moves.description: Slow low jumping sweep that knocks down after the rising blade path.
moves.reason: Low sweep leaves the ground and is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Oversoul Sword Tornado
moves.description: Slow mid sword tornado that jumps through a spinning knockdown arc.
moves.reason: Clear airborne rotating power-sword sequence with tornado and knockdown behavior.

moves.label: Crouch Guardian Flurry
moves.description: Fast mid crouch flurry with long active power-sword pressure.
moves.reason: Starts low and chains into repeated guardian-assisted blade swings.

moves.label: Crouch Oversoul Launcher
moves.description: Quick mid launcher with long active spirit pressure from crouch.
moves.reason: Crouch route rises through a white spirit-blade lift.

moves.label: Giant Oversoul Drive
moves.description: Fast special drive with very long active time that ends in knockdown.
moves.reason: Special command shows an extended Oversoul stance and sword drive.

moves.label: Rising Power Cut
moves.description: Fast mid while-standing cut with a brief active window and measured recovery.
moves.reason: While-standing route rises into the same direct body-level thrust.

moves.label: Rising Guardian Strike
moves.description: Quick mid rising strike with steady active sword coverage.
moves.reason: Rising command brings the guardian blade up through mid height.

moves.label: Ducking Power Check
moves.description: Quick mid ducking sword check with a tiny active window.
moves.reason: Down command crouches under before a compact mid blade check.

moves.label: Diagonal Blade Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active window and high whiff commitment.
moves.reason: Forward-diagonal body thrust is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Power Sword Rush
moves.description: Fast mid rush with very long active blade pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Advancing slash rush uses the enlarged blade for sustained pressure.

moves.label: Forward Power Cut
moves.description: Fast mid forward cut with a brief active hit and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command repeats the direct mid sword thrust.

moves.label: Giant Sword Tornado
moves.description: Fast mid tornado burst with long active blade reach that knocks down after the jump.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle burst shows an oversized spinning sword path and authored tornado behavior.

moves.label: Upward Guardian Ender
moves.description: Fast mid rising sword ender with long active coverage that knocks down.
moves.reason: Up command rises through a guardian-assisted slash and is authored as knockdown.
